name: ml-pipeline
description: Nightly ML pipeline: graph-sync → risk-scoring batch → early-warning threshold evaluation. Orchestrated via Catalyst Circuits.

steps.name: graph-sync
steps.description: Re-sync Data Store entities into Neo4j (AppSail). Updates offender-resolved Person nodes and FIR edges.

steps.name: risk-scoring-batch
steps.description: Batch re-score all accused with open FIRs. Outputs updated risk levels.

steps.name: early-warning-eval
steps.description: Evaluate all active AlertThresholds. Fire Push Notifications + Mail if breached.

notes: Provision this circuit in Catalyst Console > Circuits.
Catalyst Cron triggers the circuit nightly.
Each step is independently fault-tolerant (on_failure: continue).
Catalyst Signals can also trigger early-warning-eval on new FIR insert events.
